title: Shein to cooperate with French investigation into sale of childlike sex dolls
summary: Spokesperson says company prepared to share names of those who bought dolls before they were removed from sale The Asian e-commerce company Shein has pledged to cooperate with French prosecutors who have opened an investigation into the sale of childlike sex dolls on its platform. “We will cooperate fully with the judicial authorities,” Shein’s spokesperson in France, Quentin Ruffat, told RMC radio, adding that the company was prepared to share names of those who had bought such dolls.
